sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The original (Hill 1942) published it under the name Eutermes projectus, the type locality being Euston, New South Wales. The alate is not recorded in the original. The soldier is small, with a long, narrow, chestnut-brown head; the worker has the anterior half of the head dark chestnut brown and the posterior half rusty, with three indistinct brown stripes on each side.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Small, head long and narrow, chestnut brown, thorax and abdomen deeply pigmented. Head palest posteriorly, with a white median line extending to the mesonotum; the apical third or less of the rostrum dark rusty; antennae slightly paler than the abdomen; legs pale yellowish brown. Head from above (Fig. 212) slightly truncate posteriorly, the sides rounded, slightly constricted in the middle, narrowing from there to the relatively stout rostrum, sparsely covered with long hairs (as are thorax and abdomen); head in profile (Fig. 213) slightly convex above the antennal insertions; rostrum long, about three eighths of the total head length, the apex slightly raised. Mandibles with long points. Antennae long and slender, 14-segmented; segment 2 usually shortest, very rarely as long as segments 3 and 5; segments 3 and 5 equal in length; segment 4 about as long as segment 6; segments 7—9 longest. Measurements: total length 3.50 (the original gives "3.50 ?", the second value missing in the OCR); head length (to apex of rostrum) 1.70—1.72; head width 0.82—0.88; pronotum width 0.45—0.47.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Anterior half of the head mainly dark chestnut brown; posterior half rusty, with three indistinct brown stripes on each side; sutures very distinct, whitish; postclypeus dark rusty tinged brown; antennae pale greyish brown; thoracic and abdominal tergites dark chestnut brown, the trochanters slightly paler; legs pale yellowish brown. Antennae long, 15-segmented; segment 2 shortest; segment 3 long; segment 4 only slightly longer than segment 2; segment 5 longer than segment 6 and shorter than segment 3. Postclypeus more than half as long as wide. Measurements: total length 4.00—4.75; head length (to anterior margin of clypeus) 1.46—1.57; head length (to clypeofrontal suture) 0.85—0.99; head width 1.24—1.28; pronotum width 0.68—0.75.

note: Adapted from the species-level description in Hill (1942), originally in English; the original uses the old combination Eutermes projectus (now placed in Nasutitermes). The alate is recorded as "Not known" in the original, so no section is given for it. The soldier total length is OCR'd as "3.50 ?;", the second value being illegible and not supplied.
